profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Developer.

I enjoy building modern, scalable and sane software. I’ve also recently taken a dive into the role of SRE and am loving it!

I primarily work on remote teams and am very comfortable with my ability to be communicative, effective, and have integrity in a remote setting.

positions.title: Developer Advocate
positions.description:
Helping build up a strong community of developers and informing them on how to make databases easy!

At Prisma I kept up to date and familiar with a wide variety of modern technologies. These included things like:
- Languages: NodeJS
- Front-End Frameworks: React, Vue, Angular
- Back-End Frameworks: NestJS, Express, Fastify
- Full-Stack Frameworks: NextJS, Remix, Solid
- APIs: GraphQL, tRPC, REST
- Databases: Postgres, MSSQL, MySQL, Mongo, and lots more!
- Other: Docker, Terraform, AWS platform, Azure, GCP, AWS CDK

Using learnings and experience from above I gave talks/workshops, wrote articles (on the Prisma blog) and hosted online events where software development was discussed, taught and explored.
positions.insights: Front-end Development, Docker Products and +9 skills

volunteerExperiences.description: My goal as an Ambassador is to help educate the community on how and why to use Prisma by creating educational content, putting together sample projects, and interacting with the community via social media and Github.
